title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states or uses the relationship between plate voltage, separation, and electric field (E = U/d).

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Important: Applies kinematic equations correctly to find the time of flight between the plates using both horizontal and vertical motions.

title: Exit angle from plates
description: Important: Correctly calculates the angle (α = π/6) the particle's velocity makes with the horizontal upon exiting the electric field.

title: Velocity at magnetic entry
description: Important: Correctly calculates the particle's speed (v = 2√3 v₀/3) upon entering the magnetic field using the exit angle.

title: Magnetic force as centripetal
description: Essential: Applies Newton's second law for circular motion (qvB = mv²/r) to relate magnetic field, speed, and radius.

title: Geometric radius relationship
description: Important: Identifies and uses the geometric relationship between the trajectory radius (r) and the given magnetic field radius (R), where r = √3 R.

title: Central angle in magnetic field
description: Optional: Correctly identifies the central angle (θ = π/3) subtended by the arc of the particle's path within the magnetic field.

title: Final answer for B
description: Essential: Provides the correct final expression for the magnetic flux density B (e.g., B = mv₀/(2qR) or equivalent).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the charge in force equations or misidentifies the direction of deflection.

title: Unit or factor mistake
description: Pitfall: Makes an algebraic error in combining equations (e.g., mishandling the factor √3) leading to an incorrect numerical factor in the final answer.
